abstract: Sitting at my laptop to write this message feels incredibly surreal. Many aspects of my evolving role at SMPTE have been just as unexpected-like last year's Awards Gala, where you might have seen me moving a camera riser while wearing an evening gown! Transitioning from “SMPTE Sally,” working behind the scenes, to Executive Director, leading from the forefront, is a delicate balancing act.
